## Building an AI startup?

You might be eligible for our Startup Program. Get fully funded access to the infrastructure you’re reading about right now (up to $20K value).

The **Bright Data MCP server** gives AI agents and assistants real-time access to public web data through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Connect it to Claude, Cursor or any MCP-compatible client, and your agent can search, scrape and read live web pages without you building or maintaining data pipelines. Search runs on the SERP API and page scraping on the [Fetch API](/products/scrapers/fetch-api/introduction), so you never manage proxies or anti-bot handling yourself. Every new account includes 5,000 free requests per month. You can run the server two ways: a fully managed remote server, or a self-hosted local instance.

## Get started for free

Start using the Bright Data MCP server with **5,000 requests** per month, completely free.

## Choose your MCP server

## Remote (hosted) MCP

Launch a fully managed MCP server in the cloud, no setup required.

## Local (self-hosted) MCP

Set up your own MCP server instance on-premise or in your private cloud.

**Optimize your token usage:** Select only the tools you need using [tool groups](/products/mcp-server/tools) (e.g., `groups=scrapers,browser`) or individual tools (e.g., `tools=run_scraper`). This reduces context size and maximizes your usage.
